Each button runs the same play under different handlers: Play records the world's random numbers as it goes and writes the commentary onto the page; Replay answers Random from that record, so the same game comes out; the last plays games with no commentary and counts who wins.
program:
Prior art: Pig is a folk dice game, described by John Scarne (Scarne on Dice, 1945); hold at 20 is the rule of thumb analysed by Todd Neller and Clifton Presser, "Optimal Play of the Dice Game Pig", The UMAP Journal 25(1), 2004.
Prior art: effects answered by handlers you choose are Eff's (Andrej Bauer and Matija Pretnar) and Koka's (Daan Leijen).
Our own: the page, and running one game under strategy, commentary, recording and replay handlers.
